features.feature: The Vocabulary panel opens from the book beside Calls, ⌘K or `#settings/vocabulary`
"Every call" terms are added (≤ 50 chars) and removed (×) and saved, and stay every-call terms when the CLI or the app loads the settings again
"Learned from calls" lists each term with its meetings, people and calls; Always moves it to every call, Remove forgets it; a filter shows past 6 terms

Transcription hints a call with the always terms, its threads' glossaries and the learned terms of its meeting or people only; with Whisper (on this computer or an Echo transcription server) and on an OpenAI-compatible server, an utterance of 1 s or more is decoded again with the hint only when its plain decode holds something that sounds like a term not already spelled as it
